ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-like slice with golden-brown crust edges, melted pale yellow cheese topping with orange-red spots of sauce scattered across it, sitting at upper left of plate, roughly 12 cm long and 5 cm wide at widest, about 1.5 cm thick, cheese shows slight bubbling and browning | 110
ITEM 2 | Cluster of bright green florets with thick pale green stalks, slightly glossy and firm, dense tree-like heads about 2 to 4 cm across, placed centrally on the plate next to the cheese wedge, no visible char or sauce | 90
ITEM 3 | Pile of finely shredded light green and pale white leafy greens with thin pinkish-red strands, slightly wilted and moist-looking, mounded loosely in lower right of plate covering about 15 percent of plate surface, roughly 2 cm tall, with a few dark green leaves mixed in | 60
ITEM 4 | Two or three pieces of browned meat with dark caramelized edges and pale interior, slightly glossy with juices, irregular folded chunks about 4 to 5 cm across and 2 cm thick, sitting at upper right of plate, appear roasted or seared | 120
